text:
alex: quick brain dump  idea for onboarding: run an adaptive surface-sampling replay as a cheap pre-bench. pick representative request shapes from recent sanitized traces and run ~100 replays to surface tokenizer/kv/latency regressions fast.
tori: sounds promising. two questions: how do we pick buckets and avoid PII?
alex: sampler picks buckets by route/template hash and keeps only token ids + lengths. PII stripped at sampling time. buckets picked by frequency and tail-latency risk.
sam: policy: hard-fail for manifest/tokenizer/oom. distributional diffs (top-k overlap, JS) -> warn. For Dedicated/Private, warn becomes block if JS > 0.2 or p99 > 3x baseline.
rui: registry metadata constraints: keep flat. propose keys: surface.status (pass|warn|fail), surface.metrics (comma-separated p50:12.3,p95:34.2,mem:1.4GB,js:0.06), surface.buckets (pipe-separated ids), surface.artifacts (comma-separated urls), surface.run_ts. No nested objects.
tori: runner should default to CPU unless loading fails, then escalate to GPU. also sandbox network access and enforce 30s artifact download timeout.
sam: rollout: new models start in soft-canary 0.5% traffic until full bench; surface pass required within 6h or auto-throttle to 0.01%. If surface.fail -> block promotion and notify SEs.
alex: CLI example for docs:
```
redwood-surface run --model $MID --samples 100 --buckets recent_top --fast --out gs://bench/surface/123.json
```
registry sample: surface.status=warn, surface.metrics="p95:28.5,p99:42.2,mem:1.6GB,js:0.08", surface.artifacts=gs://bench/surface/123.json, surface.run_ts=1809090909
rui: metrics format makes queries easy. also add surface.runner=surface-v1 and surface.attempts as an integer string.
onboard-bot: surface queue created. sampler job will emit sanitized batches every 10m. docs: https://internal.redwood/onboard/surface
alex: i'll draft the tiny RFC with schema, sampling rules, and migration plan for high-traffic legacy models. ping me if you want to review. :memo:
